title: Mirabel and the Clock
author: Kestrel Fairweather
blurb: Noor Montrose, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
